page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It does not feature any GPU accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

Given its high density of dedicated physical cores and substantial memory capacity, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise workloads requiring large in-memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and high-performance data processing pipelines.
